a1.say: Let's solve Moving Average of a Stream, using the Sliding Window Queue approach.

a1.cap: MovingAverage(size) receives numbers one at a time with next(val) and returns the average of the last size values (or of all values while fewer than size have arrived).

a1.cap: For example, with the calls MovingAverage(3), next(1), next(10), next(3), next(5), the answer is [null,1,5.5,4.667,6].

a1.cap: Keep the last size values in a queue with their running sum. Add the new value on the right; if the window is too long, remove the oldest value from the left and subtract it.
Let's walk through it with the calls MovingAverage(3), next(1), next(10), next(3), next(5).

Time complexity is O(1) per call and extra space is O(size).
